Sales Tax Rollback

The County Clerk takes full responsibility for the ﬁnding in section 10. Sales Tax Rollback of
the audit. The County Commission and I were unaware that this was a duty of the County
Clerk during 2023 and 2024. I have calculated the rollback in 2025 and 2026 after I was
made aware of this duty and will continue to do this going forward.

As we were waiting for the ﬁnal audit to be released, no reconciliation was able to be done
for 2026, however this will be reconciled starting in 2027 and possibly beyond. Under the
direction of the State Auditor, I will discuss with the County Commission prior to the 2027
sales tax rollback how they would like me to proceed. The timeline for FULL reimbursement
of the $108,000 in the ﬁnding will be decided based on these meetings.

If you have any questions regarding this ﬁnding, please reach out to me at
jerrid.richards@coopercountymo.gov or 660-882-2114. I am committed to transparency
and answering any questions or concerns.

                                                                               Jerrid Richards

                                                                        Cooper County Clerk
